articles.summary: CALGARY, Alberta, Sept. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Enerflex Ltd. (TSX: EFX) (NYSE: EFXT) (“Enerflex” or the “Company”) has completed the previously announced divestiture of the majority of its operations in the Asia Pacific ("APAC") region to INNIO Group ("INNIO").
articles.title: Enerflex Ltd. Completes Asia Pacific Divestiture and Confirms Timing of Third Quarter Financial and Operational Results
